design_note: All foes magic - safe vs thorns.

design_note: Burning.

name: Dazzle
design_note: Blinded.

name: Siphon
design_note: Heals you 50% of damage.

name: Renew
design_note: Regen 4 turns.

name: Recall
design_note: Revive at 35% HP.

design_note: Warded - x0.60 incoming.

name: Blur
design_note: +0.20 evade.

name: Quicken
design_note: Hasted.

name: Wayfarer's Oath
design_note: CHARGE - {{name}}. Single burst. Highest power in the game.

name: Ninefold Rain
design_note: CHARGE - Vey. Multi-hit random targeting.

name: Hearthlight
design_note: CHARGE - Ansa. Party heal + cleanse.

name: Vow of Stone
design_note: CHARGE - Dorrek. Party buff + taunt.

name: Ashfall
design_note: CHARGE - Mirel. AoE damage + DoT.

name: Bloodfury
design_note: CHARGE - Skarn (roster expansion). Big single-target hit, heavy crit bonus, partial lifesteal - a reckless crit-fisher that sustains itself.

name: Spellbrand
design_note: CHARGE - Sorin (roster expansion). Armor-piercing blade strike that sears the target Frail - melee delivery, magic payload.

name: Warding Curse
design_note: CHARGE - Nyra (roster expansion). Light AoE damage plus Enfeebled on every foe - shuts down enemy offense from the back line.

name: Aegis Step
design_note: CHARGE - Brenn (roster expansion). Self Blurred (+0.20 evade) plus self-taunt - draws every attack, then dodges most of them. The dodge-tank answer to Vow of Stone.

name: Quicksilver Blessing
design_note: CHARGE - Sael (roster expansion). Light party heal plus Hasted - trades raw healing for tempo.

name: Heavy Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter (roadmap item 2). Bulk physical damage to one foe. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Wildfire
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Bulk magic damage to all foes. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Great Heal
design_note: CHARGE - MC generic starter. Heals the whole party. No status/lifesteal/condition - the plain baseline pick.

name: Reckless Blow
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop (stat-scaling set). Scales off own ATK, not camp-implied MAG. Heavy single-target hit with a big crit bonus.

name: Arcane Lance
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own MAG. Piercing magic strike that ignores 20% armour. camp=mag so the Piercing Lore bonus is dead on it despite the built-in def_pierce.

name: Shield Slam
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own DEF instead of ATK/MAG. Shield bash that cracks the target's armour (Sundered) - a tank archetype that hits with its tank stat.

name: Warded Strike
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own RES instead of MAG. Draining strike that heals 20% of the damage dealt.

name: Fleetstrike
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Scales off own SPD. Two quick hits; fires far more often than a normal charge action.

name: Battle Cry
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A rallying cry - heals the party (scaled by own ATK) and Hastes everyone.

name: Font of Power
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A MAG-scaled party heal that also grants Warded.

name: Bulwark Stand
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. Shields one ally - heal scaled by own DEF, plus Bracing.

name: Calming Ward
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A RES-scaled party heal that also cleanses one debuff per ally.

name: Fleet Step
design_note: CHARGE - MC rare charge drop. A SPD-scaled party heal plus Hasted - a courier's trick, not a caster's.

name: Tideturn
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE/TEMPO. Buys turns deals nothing.

name: Last Light
design_note: CHARGE - REVIVE at 80%. Only full recovery in the game.

name: Sundering Vow
design_note: CHARGE - DEBUFF-first. Light damage strips DEF from everything.

name: Gravewind
design_note: CHARGE - TEMPO DENIAL. Slows every foe.

name: Reckoning
power_dynamic: 2.0 at full HP rising to 6.5 on a near-dead target
design_note: CHARGE - CONDITIONAL on target HP.

name: Bulwark Oath
design_note: CHARGE - CHEAP/FREQUENT. Low rank fires often.

name: Ember Glut
design_note: CHARGE - RESOURCE. Doubles own charge rate to chain.

name: Hollow Toll
design_note: CHARGE - SUSTAIN-AoE. Heals caster 60% of total.

design_note: CHARGE - boss. Heavy single target.

design_note: CHARGE - Stone Ox. Enfeebles the party.

name: Quickened Howl
design_note: CHARGE - Mire Hound. Hastes itself.
